title: linaria × sepium subsp. ochroleuca
intro: Linaria × sepium subsp. ochroleuca, commonly known as Butcher's Broom, is a plant species that belongs to the figwort family (Scrophulariaceae). It is traditionally used to treat varicose veins, hemorrhoids, and other circulatory disorders, due to its potential health benefits, such as reducing inflammation and improving blood circulation. The therapeutic actions of Butcher's Broom are attributed to its ability to improve venous tone, reduce edema, and enhance microcirculation. The bioactive constituents of Linaria × sepium subsp. ochroleuca include saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
